reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 2025-09-03 in that channel, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that "Southgate dispatch has totes stacked beside door 4." Her resolution note later that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I didn't find a street address. The channel never gives one, and there are no Tansley account files in the share, so I suggested he ask Priyanka for the full site details. Tobias is a member of the incident channel, so I only used messages he could already read.
